title: Ancient Puzzles: Guard Break
oneLinePitch: A sprawling arcade game where ancient and tree environments host puzzle-based combat against guards, driving an evolve-to-unify arc.

pageIdentity.objective: Use puzzles and ember to survive guard patrols, secure relic routes, and turn each run into evolve, unify progress.
pageIdentity.overlayBriefing:
A sprawling arcade game where ancient and tree environments host puzzle-based combat against guards, driving an evolve-to-unify arc.

Navigate tight corridors while solving environmental puzzles to disable guards before they engage.

Manage resources like embers in an evolve-to-unify system that unlocks new abilities over time.

Evolve into a more powerful form by clearing stronger enemies, gradually shifting from evasion to dominance.

explorationLoops.prompt: What happens if pier traversal meets flame play under fort pressure?
explorationLoops.injection: Resolve the loop by rewarding quiet instead of raw score.
explorationLoops.decision: Keep flame as a repeatable skill test, escalate with fort, and use quiet as the reason to push deeper.

explorationLoops.prompt: Create an adventure game with a fire-based mechanic and tree environment where the player must navigate ancient ruins to defeat urban enemies.
explorationLoops.injection: Maintain high-energy visuals but ensure combat is played quietly without loud noises or flashing lights.
explorationLoops.decision: Finalize the game by focusing on atmospheric depth over screen-time mechanics and integrating puzzle elements that reward silence.

explorationLoops.prompt: An arcade adventure where puzzles unlock ember-based abilities to defeat a boss leader and reach the ascension stage.
explorationLoops.injection: None provided for creative variation or context override.
explorationLoops.decision: Maintain the original pitch as is without modification.

explorationLoops.prompt: Design an RPG where the player navigates ancient forests, facing goblins and serving as a bridge between two realms.
explorationLoops.injection: The game features a unique mechanic called "blink" that allows players to teleport enemies across distant ravines instantly.
explorationLoops.decision: The project focuses on environmental storytelling through tree structures and light mechanics (embers) to drive the narrative of unity.

finalSpec.playerFantasy: A master of logic and instinct who outsmarts relentless patrols in a hostile traversal world.
